name: yahwehs-globe
description: A 3D globe of the biblical world — every place Scripture names, placed as honestly as the evidence allows.

scripts.build: npm run zh && npm run events && node scripts/build-version.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:routes: node scripts/verify-routes.mjs && node scripts/verify-route-behavior.mjs && node scripts/verify-route-network.mjs
